settings.title: What is covered
settings.items:
• Help with theme settings, sections and preset configuration.
  • Fixing bugs and unexpected behaviour caused by the theme code.
  • Theme updates and maintenance releases.

settings.title: What is not covered
settings.items:
• Custom code, bespoke features and custom Liquid.
  • Third-party apps and conflicts caused by external scripts.
  • Business advice, marketing consultation and SEO audits.

settings.question: How do I switch between the Sartorial, Edition and Archive presets?
settings.answer: Open your theme in the editor, go to theme settings and choose a preset at the top of the panel. Presets change settings only, so your section content stays where it is.

settings.question: How do 3D models and augmented reality work?
settings.answer: Upload your .glb or .gltf files to the product media gallery in the Shopify admin. The theme starts the Shopify XR viewer on supported devices without any extra setup.

settings.question: How do I set up colour swatches for variants?
settings.answer: The theme reads native Shopify category swatches. Categorise the option as colour in the admin and define the colour or swatch image on the variant.

settings.intro: Dedicated assistance for merchants running this theme. Before you write, check that you are on the latest version and have a look at the documentation.
